successors.name: Sikh Empire
successors.text: Skardu Valley, 'approximately 10 kilometres wide by 40 kilometres long', on the Indus; capital Skardu

ledger.x: 1580: Ali Sher Khan Anchan expands the kingdom from Gilgit to Ladakh, taking Astore, Gilgit, Hunza and Chilas.
Date bridged: the page gives none for the loss of the conquests; kingdom shown back at Skardu after the c.
1839: Zorawar Singh defeats the Baltis at Wanko Pass and takes Skardu Fort; 1841 revolt put down; shown as lost in 1840.
Maqpon kingdom ends in Dogra conquest; Muhammad Shah kept as a subordinate raja after 1841.

certainty.note: Page gives few dates and no frontiers beyond the valley and Anchan's reach.
